generation_prompts.straw_penitent: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent idle enemy sprite candidate for Hollow Choir, a reactive turn-based pixel RPG. Reference image 1 is the existing project's cast, used for STYLE ONLY; reference image 2 is the Briarfen stage, used for PALETTE/MATERIALS ONLY. Produce exactly ONE isolated full-body creature on genuine transparent background, no sheet, no lettering, no labels, no UI, no shadow plate or vignette. Biological inhabitants are strange living organisms, not evil demons. Subject: STRAW PENITENT, an inanimate Gloamstead practice effigy dressed in faded penitent's rags. Burlap sack head with dark stitched eye marks, straw stuffing at neck and sleeves, crooked wooden crossbar arms and one blunt stick hand, tattered off-white hood and rust-brown cloth tied with rope, single stout wooden stake planted below. Humble constructed training dummy, not alive, no flames or magical aura. Distinct T silhouette, slightly leaning left; visible stable bottom of stake.

generation_prompts.ui_effects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE reusable combat UI TEXTURE ATLAS for Hollow Choir. NOT a scene. Make a precisely regular 4 columns by 4 rows atlas of exactly 16 isolated distinct pictograms, equal square cells, all evenly centred, identical visual weight, transparent empty gutters. Request 1024x1024 square canvas with 256x256 cells, each icon fits within its cell's central 176x176 area (40px empty margin each edge). Row 1 left to right: (1) BURN upright two-tongue rust-orange flame with ivory core; (2) WET single broad cold pale-blue water droplet; (3) SHOCK angular zigzag pale-gold lightning bolt; (4) BLEED diagonal ivory cut slash with one distinct rust-red drop below.
